title: Balmer series
source_status: User-provided topic sequence and dates; not independently verified

concepts.definition: Hydrogen emission n2>n1. This concept is used to interpret the observable physical effect, its measured variables, and the quantitative prediction represented by the formula.
concepts.study_guidance: Explain the physical meaning of each symbol, identify the approximation, and predict the result of changing one experimental parameter.
concepts.textbook_context: Shankar (2nd ed.), Ch. 13: Hydrogen Atom; Zettili (2nd ed.), Ch. 1: Atomic Transitions and Spectroscopy.

concepts.definition: Hydrogen emission transitions from n ≥ 3 to n = 2; higher-order Balmer lines extend into the ultraviolet.
concepts.textbook_context: Shankar (2nd ed.), Ch. 13: Hydrogen Atom; Zettili (2nd ed.), Ch. 1: Atomic Transitions and Spectroscopy.

concepts.definition: Hydrogen spectral lines corresponding to transitions from higher principal quantum numbers to n=2.
concepts.textbook_context: Shankar (2nd ed.), Ch. 13: Hydrogen Atom; Zettili (2nd ed.), Ch. 1: Atomic Transitions and Spectroscopy.

concepts.definition: The Hα line is the n=3 to n=2 hydrogen transition in the Balmer series.
concepts.when_to_use: Its wavelength is about 656 nm in air (vacuum value slightly different).
concepts.textbook_context: Shankar (2nd ed.), Ch. 13: Hydrogen Atom; Zettili (2nd ed.), Ch. 1: Atomic Transitions and Spectroscopy.

concepts.definition: As the upper principal quantum number grows, Balmer wavelengths approach a short-wavelength series limit.
concepts.when_to_use: This is the threshold from n=2 to the continuum.
concepts.textbook_context: Shankar (2nd ed.), Ch. 13: Hydrogen Atom; Zettili (2nd ed.), Ch. 1: Atomic Transitions and Spectroscopy.

concepts.definition: Hydrogen emission series differ by their final principal quantum number.
concepts.when_to_use: Lyman is ultraviolet, Balmer largely visible, Paschen infrared.

concepts.definition: An emission line releases a photon while absorption raises the atom to a higher energy level.
concepts.when_to_use: The same level spacing appears in absorption and emission when transitions are allowed.
